reviews.title: Awesome case!!!  Built like a tank with plenty of room to have a build that doesn't look cramped!!
reviews.comment:
Very Happy with this case.  I looked at hundreds before choosing this one and can't really remember why exactly I chose it over the others but I am really happy with how it turned out.  I never thought I would like a white case but after looking at others builds I just found I liked the white aesthetic better.  This case comes with 6 rgb fans as well so toss in a 360 aio or something similar and it looks great.
I have seen other case reviews where people talk about flimsy easily bent cases.. well let me tell you the Foifkin F600 I got isn't one of them.  Its well built and larger than I was expecting as I didn't really look at the dimensions all that well but that is the best part about it.  Your build doesn't feel cramped and crammed in there.  There is ample room for working and cable management is easy.
The fans that were included all match my Thermalright frozen warframe aio perfectly.  They worked great.  I had a small issue with one and contacted the seller who was super helpful and sent replacement immediately.
I love that this case is built well, I was worried about getting a thin little flimsy something that wouldn't last or would be a pain to build in.  With this case everything went as smooth as one could hope for.  The metal is solid and has some weight to it especially with the parts installed.  It doesn't feel cheap like a lot of cases I have seen and had.  I have an old hp desktop and the metal is thicker than that I am pretty sure. Its not one of those you look at it wrong it gets a bend or dent in it.  I did need to sit it good and level for the door to shut perfectly which its the same with any of these cases.  When I had it sitting on a couple different things I was having to lift it slightly into place but when I got the shelf built for it, it started opening and shutting perfect.  It just needed a flat hard surface.
The front glass panel is on hinges and the side glass has the little plastic connectors that make it super easy to pop in and out if you need access.  The top mesh comes off to clean and install aios or fans.  Not sure if the bottom does but it may as well (I checked it is removable but not magnetic).  The top one is magnetic.
The only issue I had was when I upgraded the gpu to a sappire pulse 9060xt 16gb I had trouble getting the screws in that hold the gpu to the back of the case.  The case is so solid that I couldn't push the back in and get it to go in as good as I would have liked but I still got it in.  Will have to look again though now that I got a proper screwdriver to user there.  I was improvising at the time.  To install these you need to remove a piece from the back and then open a little door which lets you put it in place.  This could be a issue with the gpu or mobo itself though as I had a rx6600 in there before and it fit just fine and the screws went in easily so I can't blame the case on that.
Also it fits the psu really well and I like the large area in the back to hide the psu instead of sticking it out in the front or beneath the case.  It just looks nice to me.  I mean everyone has their own tastes but I really like it.  I have thought of getting some of those rgb cables to go in as well.
Oh the fans in this case are already connected together so I just plugged them into the mobo and they were ready to go.  They also had the wiring for the fans done nicely it wasn't all messy looking like I have seen in some other cases.
reviews.author: kat

reviews.title: Great Case!
reviews.comment:
The case looks great and the deal there is absolutely worth your cash. 7 fans for $80, can’t beat that.
Only bother is the ssd/hdd plate holder (whatever the specific name is) is very hard to work with, my ssd would bend, there’s no clearance between the plate and ssd you just screw it straight into the case. It makes it very hard to plug cables in due to there being no clearance. If that doesn’t make sense you’ll end up running into it. I have the ssd hanging off the plate and secured it with 2 screws. It’ll do for now, but I recommend buying a aftermarket stand off that matches the dimensions of the cases.
I was surprised by the quality of the case in general and that includes the fans. The noise is minimal and they are very effective. I can feel the air flowing throughout the case when it’s open. You can definitely depend on them.
Last thing I wanted to mention is that the case is pretty big so I recommend looking at the size/dimensions of the case and make sure it aligns with the kind of desk you are running.
Great product!
reviews.author: isaias

reviews.title: Awesome quality case at an amazing value. Quality and style almost exactly matches big name cases.
reviews.comment:
The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/C1X0jrj0diL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/71xv3intTeL._SY256.jpg I was skeptical since this case is such a low price point compared to a lot of the other big name brand "fish tank style" cases I was looking at, but I have to say I was pleasantly surprised once it came in! I was going to go with a name brand one at a big box store, but I decided to roll the dice on this case for my build.
The fans came preinstalled and it came with all the hardware I needed for my build. It has plenty of slots to mount your GPU and a great mounting process for the power supply. Everything in my build fit seamlessly in this case, and it felt like everything was sturdy, attached well. I'm not a fan noise snob, so take this for what you will, but I find the included fans to be pretty quiet, not making any insane noises or making me feel like I'm sitting next to an AC unit. Keep in mind the image may show seven fans, but you will only get the 6 fans as stated in the description (which wasn't a problem because I read through the whole item description). I ended up liking their included fans so much, that I bought my seventh exhuast fan from them once the case came in. When it comes to cooling, this case stays very cool and the exhaust fan definitely helps the fan flow.
When it came to installing all the components of my PC build, I found it easier to just remove the bottom fans since they're quite seamless to reinstall. All the RGB synced up perfectly and the top power button rapidly alternates between a cotton candy blue and pink led whenever the build is on. All the I/O ports that I hooked up to the MB work perfectly and the placements are convenient.
This case has been working flawlessly for over two months now and I have zero complaints (if that changes I will update the review). The glass door is easy to remove from the hinges (just lift up vertically) during cleanings or whenever you're doing the initial PC build. Based on the way my GPU mounts to the case and the MB, I did have to get a GPU sag brace, but it was super cheap and easy to install between the GPU and bottom fans.
Highly recommend this case due to its quality for the low price point. I will be getting another one for my wife when I start her next build.
reviews.author: RJ
